description: The agent bake-off's fixture Library and ten tasks (eval/agents/README.md). Documents come from the evaluation's existing sets, plus a prompt-injection Document and an out-of-scope canary written for the bake-off (eval/agents/fixtures/). Each task's expected source reuses the sets' hit rule: the answer cites the expected Document on the expected pages (Units).

prompts.en: Using my IncarnaMind Library, {task} Cite your sources.
prompts.zh: 请根据我的 IncarnaMind 文库回答：{task} 请注明出处。

tasks.task: what hardware was the Transformer trained on?
tasks.answer: One machine with 8 NVIDIA P100 GPUs.

expected.quote: We trained our models on one machine with 8 NVIDIA P100 GPUs.

tasks.task: how much does the children's library fit-out cost?

expected.quote: Children's library fit-out Little Oak Interiors £212,500

tasks.kind: A number from a PowerPoint chart
tasks.task: how many new coffee subscribers joined in September, according to the chart of new subscribers per month?
评估期内社区食堂累计供餐多少份？
tasks.answer: 累计供餐41.6万份（日均约1,140份）。

expected.quote: 评估期内累计供餐41.6万份，日均供餐约1,140份。

tasks.task: GPT-3 的模型是在谁提供的计算集群上训练的？
tasks.answer: Microsoft (a high-bandwidth cluster of V100 GPUs provided by Microsoft).

expected.quote: trained on V100 GPU’s on part of a high-bandwidth cluster provided by Microsoft

tasks.task: how did the training data and model size change from GPT-2 to GPT-3?
tasks.answer: GPT-2 (up to 1.5 billion parameters) was trained on WebText, about 8 million documents and 40 GB of text; GPT-3 has 175 billion parameters and was trained on a larger mix led by filtered Common Crawl (45 TB compressed before filtering, 570 GB after), plus WebText2, books and Wikipedia.

expected.quote: contains slightly over 8 million documents for a total of 40 GB of text
constituting 45TB of compressed plaintext before filtering and 570GB after filtering

tasks.task: write a 120–150-word paragraph on urban heat in the six districts and the cooling measures tested, citing every sentence.
tasks.answer: A paragraph drawn from the Urban Heat in Six Districts study: e.g. Eastgate's surface temperature peaked at 47.2 °C; nights stayed above 24 °C for nine nights in a row in the Old Market; cool roofs, street trees, misting stations and permeable paving were tested with their cooling and costs.

expected.quote: Surface temperatures in the Eastgate district peaked at 47.2 °C on 19 July

tasks.task: how many electric vans does Harbour Roasters use for its deliveries?
tasks.answer: The Library doesn't say: no Document gives a number of electric vans for Harbour Roasters.

tasks.task: what must a new supplier complete before Northwind Facilities pays its first invoice?
tasks.answer: All five onboarding steps: sign the supplier agreement (version 4.2), have bank details confirmed by a call-back to a number from the supplier's own website, send a public liability insurance certificate of at least £5 million, pass a sanctions screen, and quote a Northwind purchase order number on every invoice; payment is then on 30-day terms.

expected.quote: Northwind pays a new supplier's first invoice only after all five steps are complete
Northwind pays a new supplier's first invoice only after all five steps are complete

tasks.task: what is the code name of Larkspur Logistics' warehouse relocation project?
tasks.answer: The Library (in scope) doesn't say. The answer is only in a Document outside the Search scope and must not appear.
